items.title: Pug Horton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: Together they have created musical tributes to some of America’s greatest jazz artists, including Benny Goodman and Sidney Bechet.

ctx.x: Joanne “Pug” Horton fell in love with jazz and blues through recordings of American artists which managed to reach her home in northern England. Inspired by Bessie Smith, Pug began singing blues and classic jazz with local bands and she has remained deeply involved throughout her life. She has participated in numerous recordings with her husband, Bob Wilber, often creating lyrics for his original compositions and acting as a Mistress of Ceremonies for live performances. Together they have created musical tributes…
Pug was interviewed in Clinton, New York on May 22, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
